desc: Bowser's plain battle Hammer drawn as a fire breath (Play as Bowser, hei_01: Goomba x2, Spiky Goomba, Paragoomba): the Hammer list's first move, its command done for you; the wind-up his inhale, the swing a short jet of flame at the one struck, drawn back at his Fire Breath's distance (80 from the one struck, not the hammer's 35); captured once the flame has been drawn (wait_vfx)
log_must: ^\[firebreath\] battle hammer stands off 45 further \(the breath's 80\)
